name: Corsair Lords
description: Corsair Lords was a Puerto Rican street gang from the Brownsville section of Brooklyn, with ties to Bedford-Stuyvesant, active throughout the 1950s. The gang was known for violent rivalries with neighboring Brooklyn gangs, including the Jonquils and the Chaplains. On November 19, 1958, during a rumble with the Jonquils at St. Mark's and Saratoga Avenues in Brownsville, Sidney Rhodes, 16, was stabbed multiple times in the stomach, and John Ingram, 16, a Corsair Lord, was also stabbed and died on the street. By 1959 the gang could field well over 100 members at a single gathering.
